args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failing health checks

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback:**
1. Found checkout-api on v2.3.1, unhealthy with an 18% error rate after the latest deploy. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. Rolled back to v2.3.0 — the first attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1.
3. Retried the rollback, which succeeded: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**.
4. Confirmed the service is healthy again with an error rate of 0.2%.

**Incident:**
5. Opened a **SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failing health checks after v2.3.1, the partial-failure rollback, and the successful recovery. (The first creation request timed out, but the incident had been created — verified via the incident list rather than risking a duplicate.)
